notes: Fixes the crash that met every launch of build 29. The bundled UI had grown to 11.7 MB, and handing a string that size to the Android WebView makes Chromium base64-encode it into an allocation the app cannot fit in its heap. The UI is 3.0 MB now — code highlighting ships the languages a chat actually shows instead of all 220 — and this build also asks Android for a large heap, so the same mistake cannot kill it outright. Runtime 1.6.0.
